'''Gabe Anderson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Fargo tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|bring him before me]], according to Jeff Kasper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1520">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ fargo-nd-12-9-00], DeckTech (jeff "kazper" kasper, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
Gabe Anderson is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of one card.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card was printed in [[Virtual Set 5]] (2016). The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Gabe Anderson|Card Credits]].

''Year'' is the set's release date (Virtual Sets) or the date its official text took effect (Virtual Blocks), as given in the set's article. Alternate-image (AI, ALT) and back faces are counted as separate cards, as on [[Card Credits]].
